title: X-Tiller Candidate Signal
description: One row in workspace/candidates.jsonl (the single JSONL candidate ledger since the 2026-09-24 plain-text migration). Required fields are the dedup/audit minimum every row carries; enrichment fields (author, content_hash, verification_status, suggested_action, tags, translations) and lifecycle fields (status, dismiss_reason, created_at, source_label) are optional because capture, presentation, and migration writers each set a different subset.

source_label.description: Human-readable source name copied from the registry at capture time.

title_zh.description: Ingest-time Chinese translation of title. Optional; no longer produced by current capture flow.

needs_translation.description: True when ingest-time translation failed and the title still needs a Chinese rendering.

published_at.description: Source publication time; may be absent when unknown.

excerpt_zh.description: Ingest-time Chinese translation of excerpt; the original excerpt stays as evidence.

status.description: Presentation lifecycle of the row: new (fresh), presented (shown to user), dismissed (rejected), promoted (became a topic). Dedup tombstones keep dismissed/promoted rows valuable.

dismiss_reason.description: Why the candidate was dismissed at triage (e.g. stale-news, noise).

promoted_to_topic.description: Topic id this candidate was promoted into (lineage backlink).
